description.value:
You have claimed an area or location as your demesne, granting you the ability to ward and protect it. When you select this feat, choose a demesne, an area of no more than 2,000 square feet. You must legitimately own the area or, if its a public area, you must lay claim to the area without anyone contesting it.

Once you've chosen your demesne, it's automatically protected by an arcane private sanctum spell with an unlimited duration, heightened to half your level rounded up and using your thaumaturge class DC in place of a spell DC, if necessary. Additionally, the demesne is attended by three unseen custodians, as a successful unseen custodian ritual (Advanced Player's Guide 245), and one object in the area gains an elemental sentinel, as a successful elemental sentinel ritual (Pathfinder Secrets of Magic 150).
